source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cloud data storage (PDF 159).

blocks.text: Cloud storage data ko local aalaat ki bajaye door ke servers par rakhti hai, to kahin se bhi pohancha aur aasani se share kiya ja sakta hai. Google Drive aur Dropbox users ko online files rakhne aur share karne dete hain, aur karobar backups cloud mein rakhte hain ta ke local hardware kharab hone par bhi data bacha rahe.

blocks.prompt: Cloud backup isi computer par backup se zyada mehfooz kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Computer gum, chori ya kharab ho to us par rakha backup bhi zaya hota hai, jabke cloud copy door ke servers par rehti hai.

items: Cloud storage: door ke servers par files, kahin se bhi; mehfooz backups (Google Drive, Dropbox).
